title: Step 2b - Machine Learning Basics: Training a Linear Regression Model in Python

cues.en: Instructor: Remember this, because this is your first machine learning model.
cues.zh: 請記住，因為這是你的第一個機器學習模型。

cues.en: And then you're gonna see, you're gonna use it all the time, whether you're gonna do neural networks or anything in artificial intelligence, the method that we're gonna use

cues.zh: 訓練迴歸模型的方法，就是 fit。

cues.en: And how do we call such a method?
cues.zh: 要怎麼呼叫？

cues.en: Well, first we have to take the object itself, regressor, and then add a dot, and then add the method itself which is fit and add some parentheses.
cues.zh: 先取出 regressor 物件，後面加句點、fit，再加括號。

cues.en: So as a reminder, the fit method here is a method of the linear regression class.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，fit 是 LinearRegression 類別的方法。

cues.en: And I remind also that a class, indeed, has a couple of, not only instructions, but also tools.
cues.zh: 類別不只有一組指令，也有工具。

cues.en: And these tools are called the method.
cues.zh: 這些工具就叫做方法。

cues.en: And these tools complete some actions like training a model on a certain training set or predicting some future results on the test set.
cues.zh: 方法會執行某些動作，例如在訓練集上訓練模型，或預測測試集的結果。

cues.en: So that's the first method, and you'll see that then we'll use another method.
cues.zh: 這是第一個方法，稍後還會用另一個。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So basically this fit method will train this regression model, the simple linear regression model on the training set.
cues.zh: fit 就是用訓練集，訓練這個簡單線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: And now, as you might guess, the only thing that's missing here and that we have to enter in the fit method is of course the training set itself.
cues.zh: 你可能猜得到，現在缺少、必須傳入 fit 的，就是訓練集本身。

cues.en: However, we have to enter it in a certain way, because the fit method expects a certain format of the training set.
cues.zh: 不過，fit 要求特定格式，所以必須用適當方式傳入。

cues.en: And this format is, of course, the couple of X_train and y_train, right?
cues.zh: 這個格式當然就是 X_train 與 y_train 這一對資料。

cues.en: I remind that X_train contains the features, the independent variables of the training set.
cues.zh: X_train 包含訓練集的特徵，也就是自變數。

cues.en: And y_train contains the dependent variable vector of the training set as well.
cues.zh: y_train 則包含訓練集的依變數向量。

cues.en: And the fit method here expects exactly the training set in this format with first the matrix of features X_train
cues.zh: fit 要求先傳入特徵矩陣 X_train，

cues.en: and second the dependent variable vector, X train and Y train, just like that.
cues.zh: 再傳入依變數向量 y_train，就是這樣。
